question: Why is undivided tonal sound experienced as delightful?
premises: A form made of undivided tones is delighting.
This can be observed in the recitation of rhythm.
inference: Undivided tonal continuity delights because it restores a sense of wholeness, as heard in rhythmic recitation.
plain_english: Where sound is made of undivided tones, it is delighting. Non-division brings fulfillment, as can be seen in the recitation of rhythm.
